mapper.sql: id, status, requested_case_id, requested_by, case_count, completed_count, passed_count, failed_count, average_score, prompt_id, schema_id, provider, configured_model, failure_code, started_at, completed_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sre_rca_evaluation_run ( status, requested_case_id, requested_by, case_count, completed_count, passed_count, failed_count, prompt_id, schema_id, started_at, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{status}, #{requestedCaseId}, #{requestedBy}, #{caseCount}, #{completedCount}, #{passedCount}, #{failedCount}, #{promptId}, #{schemaId}, #{startedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE sre_rca_evaluation_run SET status = #{status}, completed_count = #{completedCount}, passed_count = #{passedCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount}, average_score = #{averageScore}, provider = #{provider}, configured_model = #{configuredModel}, failure_code = NULL, completed_at = #{completedAt}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
